versions.changelog:
Initial release: Complete toolkit for creating autonomous AI agents and managing Discord channels with OpenClaw.

- Enables creation of AI agents with self-contained workspaces, custom personalities (SOUL.md), cron logic (HEARTBEAT.md), and memory system
- Integrates agents with Discord channels, including automatic config updates and optional daily memory crons
- Provides scripts to create, customize, bind, and manage agents and workspaces
- Includes tools for Discord channel creation, configuration, renaming, and workspace reference updates
- Designed for scalable multi-agent systems and seamless Discord integration
